verdict.rationale: Mercury states that Books links external bank accounts, cards, and payroll platforms, and connects to Stripe, PayPal, and Gusto. It also says transactions are pulled in automatically and categorized and reconciled in real time, which covers banking, payments, and payroll flowing into the ledger. Mercury itself notes that a connected system still leaves decisions software can't make, and the integration list is described as only a 'growing set'. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on how external connections sync (frequency, supported providers beyond Stripe/PayPal/Gusto, failure handling), independent or hands-on confirmation that third-party data lands in the ledger automatically, and broader payroll/payments coverage.
